findings.claim: The C-010 review surface is the repository's cumulative dirty diff, so this change's packet attributes substantial hunks belonging to other changes (C-001 through C-009, C-016, C-017) to C-010, violating the no-unrelated-diff-noise constraint.
findings.evidence: The CHANGELOG.md hunk in this diff adds entries for the compass agent CLI namespace, six focused skills, the compass.code_context.v1 envelope, the rmcp 2.2.0->3.1.4 upgrade, the compass-partition crate, COMPASS_MAX_GRAPH_BYTES, graph-size preflight, --exclude error text, and snapshot streaming — none of which are C-010's conformance/interop scope per its proposal; refinement_log.md Iteration 7 admits the reviewer otherwise sees 'the repository's cumulative dirty diff'; constraint 'no-unrelated-diff-noise': 'git diff and git status --short contain no unrelated or generated noise'.
findings.suggested_fix: Land the prerequisite changes' hunks in their own commits/changes first so the C-010 diff contains only conformance/CI/interop files; keep files.txt aligned with an actually isolated diff.

findings.claim: host_rejection/normalize_host reimplement rmcp's existing allowed-hosts endpoint check as a local variant, which the safe-primitives-reused constraint warns against and which can drift from rmcp's normalization semantics (e.g., trailing-dot hosts, bracket/IPv6 handling via trim_matches('[']).trim_matches(']')).
findings.evidence: transport.rs adds fn host_rejection(...) with the comment 'Mirror rmcp's effective-authority policy: an explicit Host header wins over URI authority, and a portless allowlist entry permits every port' while the router still sets config.with_allowed_hosts(...) so rmcp repeats the same check; constraint 'safe-primitives-reused': 'Existing ... endpoint checks ... are reused rather than reimplemented as weaker local variants.'
findings.suggested_fix: Rely on rmcp's with_allowed_hosts as the single enforcement point, or extract the exact comparison logic into one shared helper with parity tests against rmcp behavior (trailing dots, IPv6 literals, portless entries).

findings.claim: The diff depends on rmcp 3.1.4-only APIs but contains no Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock hunks, so the locked-dependencies and build-passes blocking constraints cannot be verified from this change and the workspace breaks if the pin/lockfile update is not landed with it.
findings.evidence: lib.rs imports CallToolResponse, CacheScope, MetaObject, ProtocolVersion::V_2026_07_28 and transport.rs calls with_legacy_session_mode(false)/with_stateless_protocol_metadata_required(true) — none exist in rmcp 2.2.0; plan.md C-007 requires root Cargo.toml pin rmcp = "=3.1.4" and constraint 'locked-dependencies' requires Cargo.lock updates accompany dependency changes; neither manifest appears in the diff or in files.txt.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the root Cargo.toml pin and Cargo.lock hunks in the change's declared file set (or record the exact prerequisite commit that landed them) so the --locked build evidence is reproducible from the packet.

findings.claim: The readiness probe silently degenerates to a misleading 15-second 'server did not become ready' failure when curl is absent, because the curl call sits in an if-condition where set -e does not abort on command-not-found.
findings.evidence: 'if curl --silent --output /dev/null --connect-timeout 1 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp"; then' inside the retry loop — a missing curl returns 127 every iteration and the script reports a server readiness failure instead of the missing tool.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit 'command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo curl required >&2; exit 1; }' preflight before the loop.
